_comment: Source of truth for what is published at https://vizora.cloud/tv and
`candidate` is the artifact verified by scripts/release/verify-display-apk.mjs.
`published` is the artifact currently live (null until the first publish); it is
the baseline the next release's signing certificate and versionCode are compared
`approval` encodes the two release gates. publish-display-apk.sh REFUSES to run
while either pair is null. Do not fill these in without the named human actually
confirming. Never put the keystore, its password, or any private key in this repo.

approval._gateA: Artifact approval — confirm this exact APK is the intended client-pilot build, not merely the newest GitHub prerelease.
approval._gateB: Signing-key durability — confirm the release keystore has a secure off-machine backup and a recoverable password owned by an authorized operator. Record location CLASS and ownership only, never the key or password.
